title: Partner trial entitlement localization & ops checklist
content:
Purpose:
This working doc lists the end-to-end ops checklist and recommended marketplace copy variants for partner trials across regions (EMEA, NA, APAC) and deployment types (hosted, dedicated, private). Goal is to reduce back-and-forth during partner onboarding by codifying gating criteria, localization rules, SKU/entitlement mapping, and telemetry signals for eligibility and conversion tracking.

Scope and assumptions:
- Covers initial 30-day free trials and partner-sponsored trials (credit codes).
- Includes flows for hosted Redwood API and Private (VPC/on-prem) where the trial experience differs (feature toggles vs license key provisioning).
- Not a legal contract; billing/terms copy must be reviewed by Legal before publication.

High-level rollout plan (ops phases):
1) Pilot (internal + 2 partners) — validate provisioning scripts, telemetry, and tile copy A/B.
2) Early partner cohort (5–10 partners) — add localized copy for fr/de/es/ja/ko, trial entitlements matrix confirmed.
3) General availability — marketplace tile published, listing telemetry in Console.

Gate checklist (must pass before listing tile goes live):
- Product/Tech:
  - Confirm trial quota enforcement: per-tenant rate limits and token caps (server-side enforcement).
  - Billing: mapping trial SKUs to free-credit buckets and ensuring metering does not bill during trial.
  - Private deploy: license key generator + validation endpoint implemented for trial activation.
  - SSO/SCIM: ensure SSO can be bypassed for trial enablement where partner requests immediate access.
  - Telemetry: events for trial_start, trial_activate, trial_convert, trial_cancel, trial_expire with partner_id and region tags.
  - Fallbacks: auto-fallback to compatible model variant when requested model unavailable; ensure fallback does not count against trial quota unexpectedly.
- Legal/Security:
  - Confirm data residency statements for each region and add explicit copy if private deployment required for compliance.
  - KMS/HSM: clarify whether trial instances get sandbox KMS or customer-managed keys (private deployments).
- GTM/Partner Ops:
  - Partner-facing trial terms and trial expiration reminders (email templates) reviewed and approved.
  - Support playbook created (runbook for expired trials converting to paid).

Trial entitlement matrix (example):
Columns: region | deployment type | default token cap | API rate limit | requires private entitlement | trial activation method
- NA | hosted | 200k tokens | 10 r/s | no | auto-provisioned on tile click
- EMEA | hosted | 150k tokens | 8 r/s | no | auto-provisioned (must show data residency banner)
- APAC | hosted | 120k tokens | 6 r/s | sometimes | auto-provisioned, but some partners require regional data center flag
- Any | private | 200k tokens | customer-configured | yes | license key issued by Partner Ops

Operational notes for private deployments:
- Trials in Private are not auto-provisioned. Partner Ops must:
  1) issue a time-limited license key tied to a tenant ID and region code,
  2) instruct partner to upload to their control plane,
  3) enable trial features via feature flag in the customer's control plane.
- For on-prem air-gapped installs, offer a 14-day offline license and require contact for extension.

Marketplace tile copy: (short + long variants — include localization notes)
- Short (English): "Redwood Inference — Fast, predictable LLM inference. Start a 30‑day trial — no credit card required."
- Long (English): "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and lower infra cost. Try Redwood Inference free for 30 days: hosted, dedicated, and private deployment options. Includes model catalog, autoscaling, and enterprise controls."
- CTA variants: "Start free trial", "Request private trial", "Get partner credits".
- Localization guidance: keep CTAs short; translate hero and one-line benefit; append a parenthetical legal link only in localized language. Avoid idioms.

Copy decision table (which CTA to show):
- If partner is marketplace-native and tenant supports auto-provisioning -> show "Start free trial" tile (hosted).
- If partner requires VPC/Private -> show "Request private trial" with a short form that creates a Partner Ops ticket.
- If partner has a reseller credit code -> show "Redeem partner credits" which opens an input modal for the code.

Ticketing/workflow for partner-requested trials:
- Minimal required fields: partner_name, partner_id, tenant_domain, deployment_type, requested_expiry_date, contact_email, KMS_required (y/n), SSO_required (y/n).
- Auto-create JIRA ticket with prefix "GT-PTRIAL-". Template attached to linked_artifacts.

Telemetry & conversion measurement (ops):
- Event schema (minimal): event_name, user_id, partner_id, tenant_id, region, deployment_type, timestamp, token_usage_to_date.
- Conversion window: 45 days after trial_start. Conversion = first successful billing charge to paid SKU.
- Funnel sanity checks: trial_activation_rate, 7-day retention (active calls), conversion_rate_by_region.

Acceptance criteria for listing: (all must be green)
- Listing tile published in staging marketplace and click-to-provision flow works end-to-end.
- Trial-enforcement telemetry appears in Console and aligns with metering.
- Support playbook validated in a 2‑incident simulation (expired trial and license key regeneration).
- Localization strings reviewed and approved for targeted locales.

Rollback triggers (examples):
- >10% unintentional billing incidents in first 72 hours.
- Trial telemetry shows >25% mismatch between issued license caps and metered usage.
- Critical security or compliance flag raised by Security team for the region.

Post-launch monitoring checklist (first 30 days):
- Daily checks: trial activation counts, failed license validations, top 5 error messages on onboarding flow.
- Weekly: conversion cohort reporting, CSAT from partner onboarding.
- Monthly: billing reconciliation and SKU mapping audit.

Open questions (to resolve before GA):
- Should partner-sponsored trials allow stacking with Redwood marketing credits? (ops/billing decision)
- For partners operating across multiple regions, do we permit single license spanning regions or require region-specific licenses?
- Exact copy for Japanese, Korean short CTAs — need native review.

Next actions (owners and tentative due dates):
- Tech: implement trial telemetry contract and export to Console (owner: Jonah Kim) — due 2025-12-15.
- Product: finalize copy and legal pre-review (owner: Lina Morales) — due 2025-12-01.
- Partner Ops: license key workflow + JIRA template (owner: Ben Chu) — due 2025-11-25.

Notes to self / rough thoughts:
- Consider a minimal partner dashboard card that shows trial progress + recommended upgrade prompts — useful signal for Account Execs.
- For Private trials, surface KMS selection early in the ticket UI so partners know implications.

Appendix: example email cadence for trials:
- Day 0: Welcome + how to get started + link to quickstart.
- Day 7: Tips to test model latency and cost controls, invite to onboarding call.
- Day 21: Reminder of trial end and benefits of upgrading + pricing link.
- Day 29: Final reminder and one-click upgrade CTA.

(End of working draft — will iterate after the tech spike and legal review.)
